listing.name: Faction Relationships
listing.summary: Adds a configurable overlay to the campaign map that displays faction relationships, sorted by status, with visual feedback for changes.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a configurable overlay to the campaign map that displays faction relationships, sorted by status, with visual feedback for changes.

description:
Small quality of life UI mod.

When jumping into systems, I never know who I can trust. This helps.

Faction Relationships Features

At a Glance

Main Campaign Map: View faction lists and relationship status directly on your navigation screen.
    Smart Sorting: Factions are sorted by relationship so friendly and hostile entities are grouped logically.

Overlay & Display

Toggle/Hold Key: Use B (default) to show or hide the list instantly.
    Configurable List Size: Display between 1 and many factions (Default: 15).
    Text Scaling: Choose between Small, Medium, or Large essential for 4K / High-DPI monitors.

Advanced Filters

Hostile-Only Filter: Focus on immediate threats by only showing factions at -50 or worse.
    Current-System Filter: Filter the list to only show factions with a physical market in your current system.
    Hyperspace Behaviour: Toggle between showing the full list or a clean UI while travelling through hyperspace.

Relationship Changes

Visual Feedback: Shows specific delta changes (e.g., +5 or -10) next to the faction name.
    Custom Duration: Adjust how long changes remain visible (10 seconds default).
    Smart Automation: 
    Option to Auto-show the overlay whenever a relationship changes.
        Option to Auto-hide after a set time (triggered by keypress, location change, or rep change).

Configuration & Requirements

In-Game Settings: All options are managed via Mod Settings %u2014no manual config editing required.
    Dependencies: Requires LazyLib and LunaLib.
    Compatibility: Verified for Starsector 0.98a-RC8.

Features include smart sorting, configurable list size and text scaling, and advanced filters for hostile factions or current system presence.
